optional_real_code_parity.scope: Native fast-decoder supported subset inside actual batch-zero LLVM ELF text; not a claim of fast decoding every AdvSIMD word.

arm64e.reason: Required ordered-memory feature is not reported by the execution host.

native-memory.reason: Backend/platform or checked-feature execution unavailable; raw test report retains every individual reason.

mops-parity.reason: Optional external real-code corpus was not set during the original cohort. A later supplied actual LLVM ELF text corpus passes the same test; see optional_real_code_parity.

bounded_bytecode_rerun.initial_stall_scope: Stock Darwin linker inside external Clang. The unbounded direct-suite completion is not used as the bounded proof; this registered CTest rerun is required.

report.scope: Arm official AEM model: EL1 CPA2 capability, all four effective CPTA/CPTA0 control combinations and EL1 ADDPT overflow controls, nonoverflow GPR/SIMD register-offset access, SP versus general-register SA controls. Normal WB memory uses separate privileged-code and EL0/EL1 RW non-executable data pages, PAN=UAO=0. No Apple silicon, EL0 instruction execution, overflowing memory/other translation/tagging/CPACHECK-choice, or NeverD output qualification.

Arm official AEM model: original EL1 CPA2, CPTA/CPTA0 and memory controls plus GPR/SIMD register-offset memory executed at EL0 in all four modes. ERET enters EL0t and the exact returning SVC site, syndrome and hardware SPSR_EL1.M are checked. Shared read-only executable code, EL0/EL1 writable non-executable Normal WB data, PAN=UAO=0. Model-only environment validation. No NeverD output, overflowing memory, every CPACHECK choice, other translation/tagging or Apple hardware qualification.

models.scope: Actual NeverD explicit-IR baseline AdvSIMD structure memory, 384-case group of unchanged 48/30-case batches covering 1134 independent LLVM MC words covering all LD1..LD4/ST1..ST4 multiple/lane and LD1R..LD4R arrangements and indices. Five unchanged source/object routes, four effective CPTA/CPTA0 modes at EL0, three post-index deltas per case. Full 128-bit vectors, completed base and every byte of 256-byte ordinary Normal WB buffers compare with independent original-register instructions. Model-only nonoverflow integer-ABI bridges; no native Apple CPA2, original SP/frame/call/unwind ABI, tagged/overflowing/foreign fault or reconstructed image qualification.
